challenge_focus: Delta pass on a test-harness fix made after the extraction challenge. The governing-chain suite failed intermittently because it piped its output into grep -q under pipefail: when grep matched and exited while the writer still held the pipe, the writer died of SIGPIPE and a passing case was reported as a failure. Both checks now read from a here-string. Check that the fix keeps every check able to fail (the suite self-check that a wrong expectation is reported) and whether it opens a new P0/P1.
